label: Superflip executable
tooltip: Absolute path to the active Jana2020 scientific Superflip executable. Default: <active Jana2020 root>\SUPERFLIP\superflip.exe.

label: EDMA executable
tooltip: Absolute path to the Jana2020 EDMA executable used for peak extraction and structure export from XPLOR density maps. Default: C:\Jana2020\SUPERFLIP\EDMA.exe.

label: Server URL
tooltip: SharpED inference server base URL. The reference client uses https://sharped.fzu.cz/.

label: SharpED access key
tooltip: User API token sent as Authorization: Bearer during upload/status/download.

label: Show beta and experimental features
tooltip: When off (default), beta and experimental Phasing methods and the settings that only apply to them are hidden entirely from the Basic tabs, not just disabled. Enable to make them selectable.

label: Algorithm
tooltip: Superflip perform keyword. Common values: CF, lde, general, fourier, symmetry; AAR is kept for executables that support it.

label: Maximum iterations
tooltip: Maximum number of Superflip iterations per run.

label: Repeat mode
tooltip: Superflip repeatmode parameter controlling repeated independent attempts and convergence sampling.

label: Random seed
tooltip: Random seed passed to Superflip. Use a fixed value for reproducibility or Superflip-supported automatic syntax if desired.

label: Delta
tooltip: Superflip delta keyword. AUTO lets Superflip estimate the flip threshold.

label: Weak ratio
tooltip: Superflip weakratio keyword.

label: Biso
tooltip: Overall isotropic B factor used to sharpen the map. Use 0.000 if no sharpening is wanted.

label: Enable final polish
tooltip: Adds 'polish yes' to the Superflip input, enabling Superflip's final polishing/refinement stage when supported by the executable.

label: Voxel grid
tooltip: Superflip voxel grid. The default omit/blank skips the keyword. Use three integers, for example 180 80 160, or AUTO to compute a 0.2 A grid from the unit cell.

label: Stored best densities
tooltip: First argument of bestdensities: how many best density maps Superflip keeps.

label: Density selection metric
tooltip: Second argument of bestdensities: rvalue, peakiness, symmetry or reference. 'symmetry' biases saved-density selection toward symmetry-consistent solutions.

label: Search symmetry
tooltip: Superflip searchsymmetry keyword: no, shift or average.

label: Derive symmetry
tooltip: Superflip derivesymmetry keyword. Common values are yes, no or use, depending on Superflip version.

label: Minimum observed value/σ
tooltip: Minimum value/sigma filter for observed reflections before writing the Superflip HKL block.

label: High-resolution cutoff dmin (Å)
tooltip: Optional resolution cutoff in Angstrom. 0 keeps all reflections; 1.2 keeps only reflections with d >= 1.2 A.

label: Normalization
tooltip: Optional Superflip reflection normalization keyword. For this Windows executable, none is the safest default and local is omitted.

label: Resolution shells
tooltip: Number of resolution shells used only when a supported Superflip normalization keyword is written.

label: Missing reflections
tooltip: Optional Superflip missing-data keyword line, for example bounds for missing reflections.

label: Electrons
tooltip: Superflip electrons keyword. Leave blank to omit.

label: Superflip threshold
tooltip: Peak threshold as a multiplier of the XPLOR map sigma. Phase Studio converts it to EDMA's absolute 'plimit <value>'.

label: SharpED threshold (σ)
tooltip: Peak threshold as a multiplier of the XPLOR map sigma. Phase Studio converts it to EDMA's absolute 'plimit <value>'.

label: Maxima selection
tooltip: EDMA maxima keyword. 'all' lists all density maxima above plimit; use more restrictive EDMA syntax only when you want to limit peak picking.

label: Atom-count mode
tooltip: EDMA numberofatoms keyword for structure export. 'composition' asks EDMA to export atom counts consistent with the chemical composition.

label: Merge distance (Å)
tooltip: Distance tolerance in Angstrom for reducing EDMA maxima to one representative per full space-group orbit before writing the CIF asymmetric unit.

label: Full-cell
tooltip: EDMA fullcell keyword. 'no' writes symmetry-independent maxima when the supplied space-group symmetry is correct; 'yes' lists the full unit cell.

label: Use center of charge
tooltip: EDMA centerofcharge keyword. When enabled, EDMA refines peak positions to the center of charge of the atomic basin before export.

label: Charge limit
tooltip: EDMA chlimit keyword. Minimum integrated charge for exported maxima; useful for suppressing noise peaks in rough or over-sharpened maps.

label: Charge-list threshold
tooltip: EDMA chlimlist keyword. Charge-list threshold, for example '0.0057 relative', used together with numberofatoms and composition-based export.

label: Elements
tooltip: Chemical elements sent to the SharpED server. Leave blank to derive unique non-H elements from the reference composition.

label: Output resolution (Å)
tooltip: Requested output sampling/resolution of the SharpED density map.

label: Map value exponent
tooltip: Reversible signed power transform sign(x)·|x|^a applied to map values before SharpED and inverted automatically on the returned SharpED map; 1.0 leaves values unchanged and 0 disables the transform. Only voxel values are affected — grid, cell, symmetry, format and the SharpED request itself are untouched.

label: Upload limit (MB)
tooltip: Maximum XPLOR map size uploaded to the SharpED server in megabytes. Use 100 MB for the current public server limit. If voxel is empty/omit, Phase Studio can add a coarser Superflip voxel keyword before map calculation so the native Superflip XPLOR fits. Set 0 to disable this check.

label: HTTP timeout (s)
tooltip: HTTP timeout in seconds for SharpED model query, upload, status and download requests. Phase Studio enforces at least 600 seconds for large XPLOR uploads.

label: Polling interval (s)
tooltip: Seconds between status polling requests.

label: Maximum polls
tooltip: Maximum number of status polls. Use -1 to wait without a fixed polling limit.

label: Input mode
tooltip: Choose whether reflections come from Jana2020 .inflip, selected overrides, or an external HKL file.

label: Jana2020 .inflip file
tooltip: Jana2020 Superflip input file. In Jana modes its fbegin/endf reflection block is the default HKL source, and its cell/space-group/composition keywords can provide the reference metadata.

label: External HKL file
tooltip: External reflection file. In Jana override mode it replaces only the fbegin/endf reflection block; in external mode it is the required reflection source.

label: HKL format
tooltip: Exact HKL column order. 'Set from .inflip' imports Jana's dataformat. The other choices use the displayed h k l · value · optional phase · uncertainty layout. Phase is in degrees; Phase Studio converts it to Superflip turns. FWHM choices describe peak width, not measurement uncertainty, so sigma-based statistics are hidden or relabeled I/FWHM.
values: h k l · I · phase · σ(I)
h k l · F · phase · σ(F)

label: Metadata source
tooltip: Selects the authoritative source for unit-cell, space-group and composition metadata, independently of the reflection-data source -- for example, External HKL input with metadata taken from a Jana2020 .inflip or reference structure.

label: Reference model
tooltip: Optional external reference. CIF/INS/RES files can provide metadata and atom sites; Jana/XPLOR/CCP4 maps can be Superflip reference densities.

label: Initial model (cycle 1)
tooltip: Optional external density or structure model for cycle 1. Supported Superflip modelfile inputs are XPLOR, CCP4 and CIF.

label: Workflow preset
tooltip: Applies a bundle of starting values for a common crystallographic workflow. 'Recommended' is a general-purpose baseline (matches the built-in defaults); the others tune settings for a specific sample type. All values remain individually editable afterward, and 'Custom' leaves everything untouched.

label: Cycles
tooltip: Number of iterative Superflip → EDMA → SharpED → EDMA cycles to run.

label: Phasing method
tooltip: Superflip runs the standard charge-flipping cycle every cycle (unchanged default). '1st Superflip, then SharpED (beta)' runs Superflip only once, then each cycle deblurs with SharpED, reads phi_calc by FFT from that SharpED map for every measured hkl, and recomposes a map from |Fobs| + phi_calc for the next cycle; it does not work well with some models. 'SharpED (experimental)' skips Superflip entirely and starts cycle 1 from |Fobs| with independent random phases; it does not work yet and is intended for development, not production use. Hidden unless 'Show beta and experimental features' is enabled on Advanced -> Setup.

label: XPLOR damping (1/x)
tooltip: Inverse XPLOR damping value 1/x. 1.0 means no damping; 0.5 is equivalent to the previous factor 2.0; 0.25 is equivalent to factor 4.0. Disabled/ignored for CIF or none.

label: Excluded atoms
tooltip: Optional atom labels to remove from CIF modelfiles before the next Superflip cycle. Use comma, semicolon or whitespace separation.

label: Model
tooltip: SharpED server model name. Use default to query /sharp-ed/models and select the server default.

label: Run EDMA on Superflip map
tooltip: Run EDMA peak search on the Superflip XPLOR map and write CIF, XYZ and PDB structure exports.

label: Run SharpED
tooltip: Run SharpED server deblurring on the Superflip XPLOR map. If disabled, the SharpED map is a copy of the Superflip map.

label: Symmetrize SharpED map with Superflip (beta)
tooltip: After SharpED deblurring, run Superflip in perform symmetry mode with the deblurred XPLOR as modelfile. No charge flipping is performed; the output map is averaged according to the supplied space-group symmetry and is then used for EDMA, Jana export, feedback and later-cycle XPLOR modelfiles.

label: Run EDMA on SharpED map
tooltip: Run EDMA peak search on the SharpED XPLOR map. Disable this when you only want map export or Superflip EDMA results.

label: Compute OMIT validation maps (5% holdout)
tooltip: Freeze a symmetry/Friedel-orbit-safe 5% holdout before the workflow and exclude it from every work-data and feedback step. Enables cross-validation metrics and profile-aware result recommendation for both Superflip and SharpED. Roughly doubles Superflip/SharpED time per cycle.

label: Calculate R_free on the 5% holdout
tooltip: R_free is calculated automatically whenever the frozen 5% holdout is enabled because it is a primary cross-validation metric. Result recommendation uses explicit lexicographic criteria; no combined numeric score is created.

label: Run EDMA on final map
tooltip: Only used by the '1st Superflip, then SharpED (beta)' and 'SharpED (experimental)' phasing methods: run EDMA peak extraction and structure export once, on the final cycle's |Fobs|+phi_calc map.

label: Working directory
tooltip: Output directory for generated HKL files, Superflip inputs, maps, EDMA results, logs and metrics.

label: Map format
tooltip: XPLOR is always produced internally (EDMA and SharpED require it). xplor keeps only that working map; ccp4 or jana additionally saves a CCP4 map or Jana m80/m81 density+reflection files. 'HKL reflections with phases' and 'ShelX (fcf)' instead save, for each cycle's Superflip map, the observed |Fobs|/intensity together with phases (and, for ShelX, calculated F squared) read by FFT from that map, in a standardized text file or a ShelX/Jana-compatible .fcf file.

label: Structure format
tooltip: CIF is always produced internally (used for metrics and next-cycle modelfiles). xyz or pdb additionally saves that structure format alongside the CIF.

label: Enable missing-reflection completion
tooltip: Enables missing-reflection completion. When off, the fields below are ignored.

label: Start after cycle
tooltip: First completed cycle whose map is used to add missing reflections for the next cycle.

label: Maximum added reflections (%)
tooltip: Maximum number of added missing reflections, expressed as a percent of the current HKL count. This prevents map feedback from overwhelming measured data.

label: Enable intensity correction
tooltip: Enables map-based intensity correction. When off, the fields below are ignored.

label: Start after cycle
tooltip: First completed cycle whose map is used to damp observed intensities for the next cycle.

label: Correction damping
tooltip: Damping factor for map-based intensity correction. 0 keeps observed data; 1 replaces them by scaled map-derived intensities.

label: I/σ(I) limit
tooltip: Correct when I/σ(I) is strictly below the limit. Amplitudes use the first-order approximation F/[2σ(F)], not recovered experimental intensity significance. Zero bypasses significance filtering for all map-supported reflections.

label: Enable powder overlap repartitioning (FWHM data)
tooltip: Enables powder overlap repartitioning: each cycle, redistribute the combined observed intensity of overlapping-reflection groups (hkl I/F fwhm data only) between their members, using intensities calculated by FFT from that cycle's processed map. When off, the fields below are ignored.

label: Start after cycle
tooltip: First completed cycle whose map is used to redistribute overlapping powder reflections for the next cycle.

label: Wavelength (Å)
tooltip: Radiation wavelength in Å, required to compute 2θ for powder overlap repartitioning. If left at 0, it is auto-detected from the Jana .m90 file, then the .inflip file's lambda/wavelength line, then from the reference file's _diffrn_radiation_wavelength tag; enter it manually if neither source has it.

label: Separation factor
tooltip: Multiplier of the mean FWHM (in the same 2θ-like units as the data) used to decide whether two reflections' Bragg peaks overlap: delta(2θ) < separation_factor * (FWHM1 + FWHM2) / 2. Matches Superflip's own fwhmseparation keyword.

label: Map ratio mix
tooltip: Blend factor for powder overlap repartitioning: 0 keeps each reflection's observed share of its group's total intensity; 1 replaces it entirely with the share implied by intensities calculated from the processed map. The group total is always conserved regardless of this value.

label: a
tooltip: Manual unit-cell length a in angstrom.

label: alpha
tooltip: Manual unit-cell angle alpha in degrees.

label: b
tooltip: Manual unit-cell length b in angstrom.

label: beta
tooltip: Manual unit-cell angle beta in degrees.

label: c
tooltip: Manual unit-cell length c in angstrom.

label: gamma
tooltip: Manual unit-cell angle gamma in degrees.

label: Number
tooltip: International Tables space-group number from 1 to 230.

label: Symbol
tooltip: Recognized Hermann-Mauguin space-group symbol.

label: Composition
tooltip: Composition in the existing Superflip syntax, for example Ag196 S108 O40 B1000.

label: Next-cycle model
tooltip: Authoritative source for cycle 2 and later. none forces the run to one cycle; superflip_xplor cycles without SharpED deblurring; deblurred_xplor uses the SharpED XPLOR map; deblurred_edma_cif ignores XPLOR damping.

label: Extra Superflip keywords
tooltip: Additional raw Superflip keyword lines inserted before fbegin. Use this for advanced/manual keywords not represented by a widget.

label: Extra EDMA keywords
tooltip: Additional raw EDMA keyword lines appended to the generated EDMA input. Use this for documented EDMA options not exposed above.
